chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, sought forgiveness for those who shaved their heads three times, and for those who trimmed their hair once.

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.لِلْمُحَلِّقِينَ: for those who shaved their heads during the rite
key_terms.لِلْمُقَصِّرِينَ: for those who shortened or trimmed their hair
key_terms.وَاسْتَغْفَرَ: he sought forgiveness and mercy from Allah

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say about those who shave or trim their hair in hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله sought forgiveness repeatedly for those who shaved their heads and once for those who trimmed their hair. It indicates a special merit for shaving the head in the rites of hajj while affirming the validity of trimming as well.
